RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, December 20, 2017/Agrahayana 29, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Skill Development and Entrepreneurship; Steel;
Tourism; Y outh Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 15
16
Disciplinary proceedings and
investigations against IPS
officers
*46. SHRI SANJIV KUMAR: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) how many IPS officers are currently
facing disciplinary proceedings and
investigations by Central and State
investigating agencies;
(b) in reference to part (a) above, in how
many cases FIRs have been registered and
after investigation, chargesheets have been
filed; and
(c) how many IPS officers have been
retired by Government by invoking Rule
16(3) of the AIS (DCRB) Rules, 1958 since
2014?
Unemployment among youth
*47. MS. DOLA SEN: Will the Minister
of LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) how many unemployed youth have
been given employment by the Central
Government during the last one year;
and
(b) how many youth were employed
during the last three years?
Revision of retail prices of petrol/
diesel/LPG
*48. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS
be pleased to state:
(a) how many times the retail prices of
petrol, diesel and LPG were revised, give
the date and the amount increased/
decreased, since May, 2014;
(b) what is the tax component in these
prices; and
(c) what are the details of variation in
crude prices during this period?

17
Investigations into killings of Kashmiri
Pandits
*49. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large
number of FIRs registered for the killings
of Kashmiri Pandits in the 1990s have not
been investigated by the State Government
of Jammu and Kashmir;
(b) whether it is also a fact that leaders
of Kashmiri Pandit body had also
approached the Central Government in this
regard but no action was taken thereon; and
(c) if so, what are the specific reasons
therefor and by when directions are
proposed to be issued to the State
Government of Jammu and Kashmir to
initiate investigations into the killings of
Kashmiri Pandits?
Fall in prices of pepper
*50. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that prices of
superior quality pepper have fallen due to
increase in its production;
(b) whether it is also a fact that cheap
and low quality Vietnamese pepper is
finding its way into India through Sri Lanka
under South Asian Free Trade Area
Agreement which is severely impacting
pepper growers in south Indian States,
particularly Kerala and Karnataka; and
(c) what measures the Ministry propose
to take to stop the unethical inflow of
inferior quality pepper from Vietnam
through Sri Lanka so that the prices of
pepper get stabilized and its growers are
protected?
Increase in prices of petrol
and diesel
†*51. SHRI NARESH AGRAW AL:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has decided to
fix the prices of petrol and diesel on a daily
basis and whether it is a fact that the prices
of petrol and diesel have been rising
continuously since this decision was taken
even as the price of crude oil is very low in
the international market;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) if not, the details of total cost of
production of petrol and diesel and their
delivery to the market?
Skill development in Saansad Adarsh
Grams
†*52. DR. SUBHASH CHANDRA:
Will the Minister of SKILL
DEVELOPMENT AND
ENTREPRENEURSHIP be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of employment
opportunities created till date for the skilled
manpower in Saansad Adarsh Grams, the
State-wise details thereof;
(b) the details of various schemes
implemented for the skill development and
creation of employment in Saansad Adarsh
Grams; and
(c) whether any assessment has been
made about the economic growth of such
villages, if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

18
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Increase in incidents of lynching by
mob
*53. SHRI M.P. VEERENDRA
KUMAR: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether incidents of lynching by
mob are reportedly on the rise in the
country and if so, the details thereof and
the reasons therefor;
(b) the total number of such cases
reported, persons killed/injured, arrested
and the action taken against them during
each of the last three years, State-wise;
(c) whether Government has any
proposal to bring a stringent law against
mob lynching and if so, the details thereof;
and
(d) the other measures taken by
Government to stop such incidents in
future?
Removal of prohibition on pulses'
export
*54. SHRI D. KUPENDRA  REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has removed
the prohibition on export of all types of
pulses;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government has taken steps
to ensure availability of pulses at affordable
prices in the country while according
permission for pulses' exports; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Encroachment of historical and
archaeological sites
†*55. SHRI PRABHA T JHA: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of historical and
archaeological heritage sites marked by
Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) in
Gwalior;
(b) whether all those heritage sites
situated in Gwalior are being protected in
appropriate manner;
(c) whether any case has come to the
notice of Government about renting out and
encroachment of the historical and
archaeological heritage sites situated in
Gwalior; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Border Outposts along India-
Bangladesh border
*56. SHRI VIVEK GUPTA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Cabinet
Committee on Security reduced the
estimated number of Border Outposts to
be constructed along the India-Bangladesh
border from 509 to 422;
(b) if so, the rationale behind this
decision;
(c) whether Government is considering
to go with original estimate of 509, if not,
the reasons therefor;
(d) the details of other measures taken
by Government to reduce the inter-BOP
distance to 3.5 kms. along the India-
Bangladesh border; and

19
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
NEW DELHI; DESH DEEPAK VERMA,
The 14th December, 2017 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 23, 1939 ( Saka)
(e) whether Government is aware of
increasing security breaches into the State
of West Bengal due to lack of sufficient
BOPs along India-Bangladesh border?
Land under PSUs in Kerala
*57. SHRI K. SOMAPRASAD: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the total area of land under the
possession of Public Sector Undertakings
(PSUs) of the Ministry in Kerala;
(b) the total market value of the land
under possession of PSUs in Kerala;
(c) the details of area of land of PSUs
sold out so far; and
(d) the amount collected by selling the
land of PSUs during the years 2014-15,
2015-16 and 2016-17?
National Minimum Wage
*58. SHRIMA TI JAYA BACHCHAN:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to fix
the National Minimum Wage;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the methodology adopted for the said
revision;
(c) whether the methodology of
determining the minimum wage is as per
any study; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the logic for fixing the National Minimum
Wage?
Talks to solve problems of J&K
*59. SARDAR SUKHDEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has authorised
any representative to talk to all stakeholders
with a view to solve long standing
problems and turmoil in Jammu and
Kashmir; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Schemes to promote work of rural
artisans
†*60. SHRI AMAR SHANKAR
SABLE: Will the Minister of MICRO,
SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of schemes or
programmes being implemented by
Government to promote the work of rural
artisans of the country;
(b) the funds allocated and used to
promote the work of rural artisans during
the last three years, the State-wise details
thereof and especially the details of funds
allocated to the State of Maharashtra; and
(c) the number of artisans benefited
from the schemes, the State-wise details
thereof?

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, December 20, 2017/Agrahayana 29, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Skill Development and Entrepreneurship; Steel;
Tourism; Y outh Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 160
111
Increase in trade deficit
481. SHRI M. P. VEERENDRA
KUMAR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the exports
have drastically come down due to which
the foreign trade deficit has reached at an
alarming level;
(b) if so, the details thereof, sector-wise
and the reasons therefor; and
(c) the names of countries with which
India has registered favourable trade
balance during the last three years, sector-
wise and year-wise?
India - Canada CEPA talks
482. SHRI MAJEED MEMON: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that even after
the 10th round of the India-Canada
Comprehensive Economic Partnership
Agreement (CEPA) talks held in August,
2017 both sides are still looking for a
breakthrough in long-pending negotiations
for a Free Trade Agreement (FTA), if so,
the reasons therefor; and
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government has agreed to accept clauses
like Ratchet and Most Favoured Nation
(MFN) in services and investment, if so,
the list of sectors India has agreed to?
Dumping of Chinese steel
483. DR. PRADEEP KUMAR
BALMUCHU: Will the Minister of STEEL
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the steel
industry in the country has been facing
innumerable problems due to dumping of
Chinese steel and downward trend of
international steel markets;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the remedial measures taken/being

112
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
taken by Government to safeguard the
indigenous steel industry?
Fall in growth of manufacturing sector
†484. SHRI DARSHAN SINGH
YADA V:
SHRIMATI RAJANI PA TIL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
growth of manufacturing sector has
witnessed unprecedented decline;
(b) if so, the details of growth in
manufacturing sector, including leather,
textiles, steel, etc. during the last two years
and the current year, year-wise;
(c) whether Government has assessed
the impact of this decline on Indian
industries;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the measures Government has taken
in this regard?
Impact of 'Make in India' programme
on industries
485. SHRI P. BHATTACHARYA:
SHRIMATI RAJANI PA TIL:
SHRI DARSHAN SINGH
YADA V:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 'Make in
India' programme has become a total
failure;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
there are adverse impacts on Indian
industries resulting in several youths
becoming jobless, if so, the reasons
therefor, including the number of people
who have lost their job, sector-wise and
State/UT-wise; and
(c) if so, the details thereof along with
the corrective steps taken by Government
in this regard especially with regard to the
possible impact on Indian industries?
Trade between India and European
countries
486. SHRI P. BHATTACHARYA:
SHRIMATI RAJANI PA TIL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the volume of trade carried out
between India and European countries
during the last three years and the current
year, country-wise;
(b) whether there is adequate potential
for Indian exports to these countries;
(c) if so, the details thereof along with
the steps taken by Government to increase
the exports to these countries and to explore
the new markets; and
(d) the success achieved by Government
in this regard?
Protection against cheap and sub-
standard imports
487. SHRI NARAYAN LAL
PANCHARIYA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
any measures to protect the interest of
Indian manufacturers against cheap and
sub-standard imports;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;

113
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether any step is being taken to
promote that the goods imported into India
have some local sourcing connection; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Expenditure on 'Startup India'
programme
488. SHRI TIRUCHI SIV A: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) how many Startups have been
benefited under the 'Startup India' scheme;
(b) how much expenditure has been
incurred by Government over the 'Startup
India' programme; and
(c) what is the estimated number of
people employed in these 'Startups'?
Pending FDI proposals
489. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of pending FDI proposals
and the reasons therefor;
(b) the details of FDI proposals that
have been cleared since 2014, till date; and
(c) the details of FDI proposals that
have been rejected since 2014 till date, the
reasons therefor?
Fall in Indian brand value
490. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian brand
value has fallen in the international market,
the details thereof and the reasons therefor;
and
(b) the details of steps taken by
Government to arrest this fall of Indian
brand in the international market?
Increase in imports
491. SHRI ANIL DESAI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India imported goods worth
19 billion US dollars in 2017 as compared
to 13.5 billion US dollars in the previous
year;
(b) whether the appreciation of the
rupee allowed Indian importers to purchase
larger quantities of goods at lower prices;
and
(c) if so, what right steps are being taken
by Government to encourage domestic
industry so that it could generate income
and jobs and reduce India's dependence on
imports, giving boost to 'Make in India'?
Decline in trade
†492. SHRI SURENDRA SINGH
NAGAR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of import and export from
India in terms of both rupee and US dollar
during the last three financial years
2013-14, 2014-15 and 2015-16,
respectively and the current financial year;
and
(b) the details of the items showing
declining trend in both these sectors and
the main reasons for slow down therein?

114
Shift in manufacturing and export
strategy
493. SHRI T. RATHINA VEL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is considering a shift in India's
manufacturing and export strategy with a
focus on new emerging sectors such as
genomics, while giving a thrust to export
of goods that are not currently among the
top 10 items shipped out of the country;
(b) whether India has to put in place its
own model as it seeks to increase the share
of manufacturing in GDP from the current
level of under 30 per cent to increase
employment and also help agriculture in
segments such as food processing; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Expenditure on CSR by PSUs
494. SHRI K. SOMAPRASAD: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the total amount of expenditure on
Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) by
each Maharatna PSU of the Ministry
during the years 2014-15 to 2016-17; and
(b) the total expenditure on CSR for
SCs/STs by each Maharatna PSU during
the years 2014-15 to 2016-17?
Implementation of GST under the
Ministry
495. SHRI C. M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the status of implementation of GST
in various sectors under the Ministry;
(b) whether it is a fact that ` 65,000
crores are to be refunded to exporters
during July-October, 2017;
(c) if so, details of steps taken to
quicken the process to return their dues in
a time-bound manner;
(d) whether it is also a fact that seven
export promotion councils represented this
matter to the Ministry; and
(e) if so, what action has so far been
taken in this regard?
India's ranking in 'Ease of Doing
Business'
496. SHRI C. M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) India's rank in the 'Ease of Doing
Business' rankings;
(b) to what extent the easing of
procedures to get construction permit helps
India to climb its 'Ease of  Doing Business'
ranking;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
World Bank officials travelled to Delhi and
Mumbai to assess the procedures eased by
the country to take a final call on rankings;
and
(d) if so, the detail thereof?
New Industrial Policy
497. SHRIMATI SAROJINI
HEMBRAM: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the New Industrial Policy
of Government has been finalised;

115
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
overall reforms made in this policy; and
(c) if not, when is it going to be finalised
and implemented?
Results achieved by 'Make in India'
and 'Startup India' schemes
498. SHRI NARENDRA KUMAR
SWAIN: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
various initiatives launched by Government
like 'Make in India' and Startup India' did
not fructify desired results in both urban
and rural areas;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and if not,
the details thereof; and
(c) what action plan Government
considers to give employment to highly
educated youth of urban and rural areas?
Impact of antibiotics on shrimp
exports
499. DR. R. LAKSHMANAN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether instances of detection of
antibiotics such as nitrofuran and
chloramphenical in shrimp exported from
India have adversely affected its export to
foreign countries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has taken any
initiative to prevent the use of antibiotics
in aquaculture; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Measures to boost exports
500. SHRI HARIVANSH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any plan
to prepare a new strategy to make country's
exports a major source of economic
growth;
(b) if so, what are the measures that are
proposed to be taken to boost the exports;
and
(c) what has been the contribution of
exports to country's GDP during the last
three years?
Transfer of salt pan land in Mumbai to
Maharashtra
501. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether any proposal is pending for
transferring salt pan land in Mumbai
Metropolitan Region to State Government
of Maharashtra for construction of
'Affordable Housing' to achieve the
objective of 'Housing for All by 2022'; and
(b) if so, Government's response thereto
and by when it will transfer the land to the
State Government?
Import of mobile handsets
502. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of mobile handsets
imported during the years 2014-15,
2015-16 and 2016-17 along with the
amount of foreign exchange spent thereon;
(b) the value of mobile handsets
produced in the country during the last
three years; and

116
(c) whether Government has taken any
step to encourage multinational companies
to set  up manufacturing units in the country
pursuant to the announcement made by
Prime Minister in this regard and if so, the
outcome thereof along with the details of
such units set up so far in the country?
Trade fairs/exhibitions at Pragati
Maidan
503. SHRI PARIMAL  NATHWANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of various exhibitions/
international trade fairs organized at Pragati
Maidan, Delhi and the expenditure
incurred thereon/the revenue earned by
Government during the last three years;
(b) the main theme of the recently held
India International Trade Fair and how
many visitors attended the fair; and
(c) the details of participation of foreign
companies and countries, the number of
MoUs signed and quantum of foreign
exchange earned?
Economic sanctions against North
Korea
†504. SHRI MAHENDRA SINGH
MAHRA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India is one of those
countries of the world which have imposed
economic sanctions against North Korea;
(b) if so, the names of those countries
which have imposed economic sanctions
against North Korea;
(c) if so, on what basis North Korea is
exporting commodities to India, the details
thereof; and
(d) whether trade relations with North
Korea exist despite sanctions?
Use of trade policy for employment
generation
505. KUMARI SELJA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
use trade policy as an effective instrument
of growth by giving a thrust to employment
generation, especially in semi-urban and
rural areas; and
(b) if so, what steps are to be taken to
implement the schemes seriously?
Fall in pharmaceutical exports
506. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn towards the falling
pharmaceutical exports from the country;
(b) if so, the reasons for the decline and
the percentage of exports by
pharmaceutical sector in the financial years
2014, 2015 and 2016;
(c) whether Government is planning to
come out with a report that will study the
impact of fall in pharmaceutical exports on
domestic growth in the country; and
(d) if so, the likely time by when the
report will be made available?
Salient features of Project 'Mausam'
507. SHRIMA TI JAYA BACHCHAN:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the salient features of Project
'Mausam' along with its present status;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

117
(b) the details of the funds sanctioned,
allocated and utilised under this project,
since its inception, State/UT-wise;
(c) the number of States/countries
involved under this project at present;
(d) whether Government has fixed any
time-frame for this project; and
(e) if so, the details thereof along with
the achievements made so far and its
response with the other countries?
Survey by ASI in the holy places of
Karnataka
508. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) when was the last survey undertaken
by the Archaeological Survey of India
(ASI) of the ancient buildings and religious
sites in the holy places of Karnataka;
(b) what was the recommendation of the
ASI; and
(c) whether Government proposes to
ensure proper preservation of the heritage
sites in the holy cities of Karnataka?
Declaration of Begumpuri Masjid and
Sarai Shahji monuments in Delhi as
protected monuments
509. SARDAR BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Archaeological Survey of
India (ASI) has declared Begumpuri
Masjid and Sarai Shahji monuments in
South Delhi as protected monuments and
no construction or alteration/modifications
in existing properties within a specific
radius of these monuments is permitted
without the permission of ASI;
(b) if so, details thereof;
(c) whether Government has received
complaints for modification, additional
construction by some residents on
Panchsheel-Gitanjali Road which falls
within the jurisdiction of protected
monuments viz. Begumpuri Masjid and
Sarai Shahji; and
(d) if so, what action has been taken to
demolish additional construction carried
out by residents without permission of ASI?
Financial assistance under the Scheme
of Building Grants
510. SHRIMA TI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether financial assistance under
the Scheme of Building Grants, including
Studio Theatre to support voluntary
cultural organisations and Government-
aided cultural organisations, has been
granted by Government in the country;
(b) if so,the details thereof along with
the financial assistance under the scheme
granted during the last three years and the
current year, organisation-wise;
(c) whether Government has conducted
any inspection so as to ensure proper
utilisation of grants; and
(d) if so, the details of irregularities
found and the action taken against such
organisations by Government,
organisation-wise?
Funds to protected monuments in
Maharashtra
†511. SHRI AMAR SHANKAR
SABLE: Will the Minister of  CULTURE
be pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

118
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
makes the budgetary allocation for the
development of centrally protected
monuments;
(b) if so, the financial assistance
allocated and utilized by the Ministry
during the last three years, for the various
protected monuments in the State of
Maharashtra; and
(c) the specific achievements made
through these protected monuments?
Cultural mapping of India project
512. SHRI MAHESH PODDAR: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) the total number of artists State-wise
which have been recorded in the database
of cultural mapping of India project, so far;
and
(b) what fiscal and other support is
being extended to them?
Promotion of cultural traditions, arts,
literature, etc. of rural and tribal areas
†513. SHRI SURENDRA SINGH
NAGAR: Will the Minister of CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any plan
to promote the cultural traditions, arts,
literature, folk arts and songs of rural and
tribal areas of the country that are becoming
extinct, if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether Government has made any
